title: Google AI Overviews become more common in search
slides: Google just made AI Overviews harder to avoid in search.
They now appear for far more queries than before.
But the change actually cuts organic click-through rates sharply.
Your site must now optimize for zero-click answers to stay visible.
Check your own queries today for unexpected AI summaries.
thread_text:
Your clicks just got cheaper.

Google expanded AI Overviews to more searches. Early data shows organic click-through rates dropping by double digits.

Why visibility is the new trap.

Being the first result used to mean traffic. Now Google keeps users on its own page with AI summaries.

Zero-click is the new first place.

Your site can still appear in the overview. But users get the answer without ever leaving Google.

Optimize for the snippet, not the click.

Rewrite content to answer questions directly. Use structured data and bullet points to win the AI summary slot.

Run your top 10 queries today.

Open an incognito window and search. Count how many show an AI box. That’s your new competition.
